title: Travel Completed | APPR / Star Alliance | OAL Cancellation | Code TECH(Aircraft Technical Issue) -DMT (Upline Safety) | Rebooked (6�9h delay) | Single Leg OAL (Star) | Elite 35K
description:
Validates an all-OAL itinerary operated by a Star Alliance partner (United Airlines) where the original flight is involuntarily cancelled due to Code TECH(Aircraft Technical Issue) - DMT (Upline Safety) and rebooked onto a later flight, resulting in a 7-hour arrival delay at the final destination DEN (6�<9h delay band). Passenger holds Aeroplan Elite 35K status on an Air Canada issued ticket (014- ticket stock). Validates that: (1) DDS scans all legs and confirms zero AC-operated segments exist on the itinerary, (2) Under APPR, the operating carrier (United Airlines) is responsible for disruption handling rather than the ticketing carrier (Air Canada), (3) Chatbot recognizes the Star Alliance partner and provides a direct redirect/guidance to United Airlines for claim processing, (4) Aeroplan Elite 35K profile status is recognized but does not override operating carrier liability rules, (5) Code TECH and all-OAL operation result in $0 Air Canada direct liability with no automated payout triggered.
Prerequisites:
PNR: TC037 � single passenger Richard Clarke (Adult - Aeroplan Elite 35K). Ticket stock: 014- (Air Canada issued ticket). Journey: 1 leg, Original Flight UA 4521 (AC Codeshare AC 4521), Chicago (ORD) ? Denver (DEN). Operating carrier: United Airlines (UA � Star Alliance partner) � NOT Air Canada. Disruption: Original flight cancelled at D-1 due to Code TECH(Aircraft Technical Issue)[DMT (Upline Safety)]. Rebooking: INVOL rebooked by UA onto flight UA 4525, scheduled arrival 14:00 ? actual arrival 21:00 (7hr arrival delay at destination DEN, 6�<9h band). Cancellation code: TECH(Aircraft Technical Issue)[DMT (Upline Safety � Star Alliance)]. ALL legs on itinerary: OAL operated (zero AC operated segments). Regime: APPR (Operating carrier rule applies). Aeroplan: Linked (9876543210), Status = Elite 35K, in good standing. 72hrs: Elapsed (filed D+10). Time limit: Within 366 days. No duplicate case. CyberSource: NOT invoked (not eligible case). RDS: No flags.
